hook_text: Look at a map of Europe in 1915. Why did Germany feel surrounded?
clip_script: Colour the Central Powers: Germany, Austria-Hungary, Bulgaria and the Ottoman Empire, a band across the middle of the map. Now colour the Allies: France and Belgium to the west, Britain across the sea, Russia to the east, Italy to the south, Serbia in the Balkans. Add a British naval blockade in the North Sea. Germany is boxed in. Then the war spreads: Gallipoli, the Middle East, Africa. South Africa invades German South West Africa. In 1917 the United States joins. A European war has become a world war.
visual_style: A whiteboard map of Europe being coloured in two colours, with blockade ships, front lines and arrows spreading to Africa and the Middle East.
pacing: Builds the map country by country.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to master the Allied and Central Powers.
